name: Wilson Resistance Salvage Works
franchise: Entropy: Zero 2 — fan-made Half-Life 2 mod by Breadmen
backstory: A personable turret becomes a mobile arena contender through an adapted transport mount. Two supported close-range allocations carry the workshop's concentrated equipment investment.
strategy_personality: A personable automated turret gives this fan continuity a genuine machine candidate. Preserve Wilson's source shell, optic, and recognizable turret construction rather than converting the human protagonist into a robot. The arena version needs an explicit mobility and equipment decision; any added transport chassis is an adaptation. Confirm the released mod's reference model before portrait production, and label the entry as fan continuity throughout the blueprint.

robots.art_brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around every extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.


Subject: ONE Wilson, the friendly defective prototype turret from the released Entropy: Zero 2 fan mod, using the central outlined turret in the attached developer screenshot as source: tall narrow dark graphite/grey oval industrial turret housing, a single central RED ring optic, folded angular stabilizer legs and source equipment panels. Preserve the actual turret silhouette and dark mechanical construction, no human or Combine soldier body and no Portal white egg-shell turret. Its original supporting struts fold neatly into an explicitly ORIGINAL arena transport cradle mounted on two small caterpillar tracks; the tracked mobility base is an arena adaptation, not mod canon. Existing turret barrels remain inactive. One complete unified machine, no humanoid arms or head, all casing and tracks visible. Do not reproduce green game outline or caption.
Metadata only, do not render text: #199 slot 1 Wilson.
robots.refinement_note: Apply only after the final loadout is equipped. Main-hand operations affect that item instance only; a second weapon copy stays unrefined. The shield receives only its listed Hone. No unverified weapon attribute is added.
robots.equipment_interpretation: Wilson fills the mobile paired-fire attacker role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. Arena main/offhand allocations can use fitted mounts or tool adapters; extra limbs, integrated source weapons and alternate forms grant no additional slots or combat effects.
robots.combat_rationale: Sprinter tuning supports the short equipment role; offensive stance and a 10% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Paragon strategy tuning rules with the Sprinter Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.
robots.design_basis: New arena build authored for this collection using supplied equipment prices, hand compatibility and verified refinement examples. Original source identity and final artwork remain authoritative for appearance.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** Entropy: Zero 2 — fan-made Half-Life 2 mod by Breadmen  
**Strategy:** Paragon · **Target roster:** 1 robot

**Proposed robots:** Wilson.

**Direction:** A personable automated turret gives this fan continuity a genuine machine candidate. Preserve Wilson's source shell, optic, and recognizable turret construction rather than converting the human protagonist into a robot. The arena version needs an explicit mobility and equipment decision; any added transport chassis is an adaptation. Confirm the released mod's reference model before portrait production, and label the entry as fan continuity throughout the blueprint.

References: [developer's community-mod release page](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1583720/Entropy__Zero_2/), [Breadmen's developer profile naming Wilson](https://www.moddb.com/company/breadmen).

**Production edition:** Entropy: Zero 2, Breadmen fan continuity; source turret plus original mobile arena transport.  
**Catalogue key:** `wilson-resistance-salvage-works`
purchasing_plan: Open and remain at one robot. Buy its complete stage-1 loadout before refinement. Execute the listed steps in order, progressing Workshop L1/L3/L5/L8 as required. Keep prestige-gated steps pending; fund repairs and maintenance before every purchase.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
